headline: Bitcoin slipped back under $60,000 on Saturday as US bitcoin funds logged an eighth straight day of withdrawals in what is already a record month for outflows.

market.asOf: Prices read on alternative.me's crypto dashboard at about 07:58 UTC Sat 28 Nov (14:58 Bangkok; 2:58am ET); solana's 24h change was shown without a sign, so it is left out. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Two indexes, both in fear: CoinMarketCap Fear & Greed 10 (read on CoinMarketCap's charts page) and alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed 12, Extreme Fear, both read at about 07:58 UTC 28 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin gives back Friday's bounce and is under $60,000 again
stories.summary: Bitcoin touched about $62,100 on Friday but could not hold it, and early Saturday it was back below $60,000, with ether falling further.
points: Bitcoin was down 3.23% at $59,710.30 at 01:07 ET (06:07 GMT) on Saturday, after a Friday high of $62,125 and a low of $58,719, per Investing.com.
Ether fell 4.48% to $1,656.85, and about $478 million of positions were liquidated across the market, per Investing.com.
Bitcoin fell 26.3% from $81,255 on 28 Oct to $59,857 at the 27 Nov close, per crypto.news using Investing.com data.
Bitcoin's 50-day average is about 3.45% above its 200-day average, down from a 12% gap a month ago, so a so-called death cross could come soon; CoinDesk notes such signals lag the price.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds see an eighth straight day of withdrawals in a record month; Strategy leaves MSCI's indexes Monday
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds lost another $389 million on Friday, most of it from BlackRock's fund, making November the biggest month of withdrawals on record. On Monday after the close, MSCI drops bitcoin treasury company Strategy from its indexes, which could make funds that track them sell its shares.
points: Spot bitcoin funds had net outflows of $389 million on Friday 27 Nov, the eighth straight session, with $327.2 million from BlackRock's IBIT, per Farside data via crypto.news.
November outflows reached $5.78 billion including Friday, per Farside data via crypto.news, already above the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June, per CryptoBriefing via KuCoin.
US ether funds lost $69.4 million on Friday and $592.7 million over nine straight sessions, per crypto.news.

MSCI's removal of Strategy takes effect after the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million Strategy shares, 3.1% of its shares, and JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: Binance's hack withdrawals are back; an Abu Dhabi court weighs the frozen funds on Tuesday
stories.summary: Binance says the withdrawal suspension from its 29 October hack is fully lifted, with a few networks paused for maintenance. An Abu Dhabi court holds a hearing on 1 December on whether firms must keep hack-linked tokens frozen.
points: Binance said the withdrawal suspension has been fully lifted and withdrawals for a small number of networks are temporarily paused for maintenance or planned upgrades; about $6.3 billion was affected, per CoinDesk.
The ADGM Courts in Abu Dhabi issued a $6.5 billion worldwide freezing order covering 26,000 addresses, and about $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted, per The Block.
A 1 Dec hearing will consider whether 18 firms, including Circle and World Liberty Financial, must keep hack-linked tokens frozen, per Reuters via The Star.
11,989 ETH, about $19.7 million, moved on Friday from an address labelled "Binance Hack 2026" to an unidentified wallet, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Big holders kept buying
briefs.summary: Wallets holding 1,000 to 10,000 BTC added 121,117 BTC between 30 Sep and 21 Nov, to 2.95 million BTC, per CryptoQuant data cited by Investing.com.

briefs.title: XRP funds buck the trend
briefs.summary: US XRP funds took in $5.4 million on Friday while bitcoin and ether funds lost money, per SoSoValue data cited by crypto.news.

briefs.title: Malaysia's first spot bitcoin fund eyes a 2 Dec debut
briefs.summary: The Halogen Shariah Bitcoin ETF is aiming to list on Bursa Malaysia's Main Market on 2 Dec, per The Edge Malaysia, based on its draft prospectus.

briefs.title: KuCoin delists Monero on Monday
briefs.summary: KuCoin removes its XMR spot pairs at 08:00 UTC on 30 Nov; withdrawals stay open until 31 Dec, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: Spain lets its financial watchdog freeze crypto accounts
briefs.summary: A new decree lets Spain's financial intelligence unit freeze crypto accounts for up to 5 business days without a court order, from 25 Jan 2027, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.note: The Fed's blackout began at 12:00am ET Sat 28 Nov and runs to 11:59pm ET Thu 10 Dec, per the Fed's blackout calendar; its December calendar lists no speeches, only Bowman's testimony on 1 Dec.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: PROS, FF, CARDS, GRVT, KMNO, GUN, EIGEN, SUI, ZETA, BTW, ENA, 2Z, Q, STO, MMT, LA
calendar.note: PROS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30 (trackers disagree on GUN's day); EIGEN, SUI and ZETA on Tuesday 1 Dec; BTW, ENA, 2Z and Q on Wednesday 2 Dec; STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec; a second ENA tranche on Saturday 5 Dec. See the unlock table on this page for sizes and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
OPEC says "The next meeting will be held on 29 November 2026." Time not announced.
176 of 350 seats are needed for a majority; polls point to a PP-Vox majority, per Newsquawk.
XMR spot pairs are removed at 08:00 UTC; withdrawals stay open until 08:00 UTC 31 Dec, per KuCoin.

calendar.event: Trump Media (DJT) noteholders can demand repayment
calendar.note: About $883.5 million of convertible notes remain outstanding and holders may require repurchase for cash on 30 Nov, per Finviz. Time not published.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect after the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of its shares; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed's Bowman testifies to the House
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55.2, October 55.5, per Economic Weekly. JOLTS: September was 7.5 million, per the BLS. Bowman testifies on oversight of prudential regulators at 10:00am, per the Fed's calendar. An Abu Dhabi court hearing on the frozen Binance-hack tokens is also on 1 Dec, per The Defiant. Marvell reports after the close, per StockTitan.

calendar.event: ADP private payrolls (Nov); Salesforce and Snowflake earnings
calendar.note: ADP: consensus 80,000, October 86,000, per Economic Weekly. Salesforce and Snowflake report after the close, per StockTitan.

calendar.event: US jobless claims; ISM services PMI (Nov); Jensen Huang at Senate Banking
calendar.note: Claims: consensus 193,000, prior 189,000. ISM services at 10:00am: consensus 54.5, October 54.5. Both per Economic Weekly. Huang testifies to the Senate Banking Committee at 10:00am, per Newsquawk.
Consensus +90,000 jobs with unemployment at 4.1%; October was +165,000 and 4.1%, per Economic Weekly.

calendar.event: Fed meeting ends (8-9 Dec); Powell press conference
calendar.note: The Fed's December calendar lists the two-day meeting on 8-9 Dec and the press conference at 2:30pm ET. November CPI follows on Thu 10 Dec at 8:30am ET, per the BLS schedule, so the Fed decides before seeing it.
